description: This file contains integration tests for the CatalogItem endpoints of the Public API in the eShopOnWeb project. It tests the retrieval of catalog items with pagination and parallel API calls.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Contains integration test methods for catalog item list API endpoints, including pagination and parallel calls.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that the API returns exactly 10 catalog items when requesting page size of 10.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Verifies that pagination correctly returns the expected number of items for page index 1.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Checks that multiple parallel API calls to various endpoints succeed with HTTP 200 OK status.
